booking_jurisdiction: jurisdiction with high AML scrutiny (e.g., CH, SG, HK)
product_type: product_type = fx_conversion or securities_trade with high amount
beneficiary_country: beneficiary_country high-risk (IR, RU, CN) with cross-border flow
swift_mt: missing MT code for wire transfers
swift_f71_charges: charges field empty for large transfers
fx_market_rate: market rate missing or zero for FX transactions
kyc_last_completed: last KYC date older than 2 years
narrative: narrative contains unrelated or filler text
sanctions_screening: screening result = potential or match with high-risk entities
